user.title: Siemens LOGO! (Modbus TCP)
user.description: Enter the address of the LOGO! and how many outputs (Q) and inputs (I) to show. Modbus server must be enabled on the LOGO! (Soft Comfort: Tools → Ethernet Connections).

data_description.host: IP address of the LOGO!, e.g. 192.168.0.230.
data_description.outputs: Creates switches Q1…Qn. Each switch writes flag Mn and shows the real state of Qn (0–20).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the state is read, in seconds (1–60).
How often the state is read, in seconds (1–60).
